stem_glosses.piel: give a tithe; take a tithe (of the tithe, Levitical)

notes: Requested hiphil "take a tithe" has zero attestation -- every occurrence of this lemma is qal or piel, and the lexicon ("to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth") doesn't stem-differentiate the two directions either. The "take a tithe" sense the request wanted for hiphil is actually attested under piel itself: Neh.10.38, "בְּעֶשֵׂר הַלְוִיִּם" ("when the Levites take tithes", the Levites' own collection of a tenth from the people's tithes), alongside piel's more common "give a tithe" sense (Deut.14.22, Gen.28.22). Excluded hiphil; broadened piel's gloss instead.

Root-key split: this root (עשר, "to tithe") is spelled identically to the existing עשר "become rich" (H6238) -- the lexicon itself notes H6237 is "identical with H6238" as a consonant skeleton but a separately-numbered, functionally distinct denominative (from עֶשֶׂר, "ten") -- same convention as חפר¹/², גאל¹/², יצר¹/², קוץ¹/². This root (the lower number) is עשר¹; H6238 has been retroactively relabeled עשר².
